five_w.who: Lifestyle and craft influencer sharing a trendy weekend activity with enthusiasm and internet slang.
five_w.says_what: Attending a Saturday afternoon paper-cutting workshop, using a red paper and carving tool starter kit, and learning symmetrical folding for window flowers from a heritage inheritor's assistant.
five_w.channel: Instagram: short, highly visual, emoji-friendly, and scroll-friendly with an engaging closing question.
five_w.to_whom: UK audience: connects with their love for weekend DIY and crafts by comparing it to traditional British knitting.
five_w.effect: Spark curiosity about the satisfying visual process of paper-cutting and encourage comments/shares about trying new crafts.

post: Swap your usual weekend craft for something totally different! ✂️✨ Just dropped into an amazing paper-cutting workshop this Saturday afternoon. They handed us a starter kit with red paper and carving tools. 🧧 Our tutor (an assistant to a provincial heritage inheritor!) taught us symmetrical folding for window flowers. It’s so satisfying watching the patterns unfold! 🤯 Perfect for leveling up your UK weekend DIY game. 🇬🇧 Would you try this or stick to knitting? 👇
ops_tips: Pair with a high-quality carousel: 1) action shot of carving, 2) the unfolding symmetrical window flower reveal, 3) the starter kit flatlay.
Use a trending, upbeat lo-fi or acoustic audio track to match the cozy weekend craft vibe.
evidence_notes: Evidence#1 -> Saturday afternoon workshop, starter kit with red paper and carving tools.
Evidence#2 -> Tutor is an assistant to a provincial intangible heritage inheritor; learning symmetrical folding for window flowers.
